title: Vietnamese Italian Stir-Fried Chicken
description: A fusion of Vietnamese and Italian flavors, this dish combines the spice of Vietnamese stir-fry with the heartiness of Italian cooking. This recipe is perfect for a quick and delicious dinner.
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the chicken to the skillet and cook until browned, about 5-6 minutes.
Remove the chicken from the skillet and set aside.
Add the remaining 1 tablespoon of olive oil to the skillet.
Add the garlic, red bell pepper, and onion to the skillet and cook until the vegetables are tender.
Add the Italian seasoning, Vietnamese fish sauce, and rice vinegar to the skillet and stir to combine.
Return the chicken to the skillet and stir to coat with the sauce.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve the chicken hot, garnished with herbs if desired.
